Restaurant jaisa Shahi Chicken Handi ab ghar par banaiye! ( ) krimi kaju ki gravy, juicy chicken aur smoky tadka ka shandar combination. Enjoy this rich and flavourful Indian chicken curry with naan or tandoori roti.
Preparation time 10-15 minutes
Cooking time 25-30 minutes
Serve 2-4
Ingredients
For Paste
Water as required, pani
Salt to taste, namak svadaanusar
